title: ICYMI LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial (October 9, 2026)
summary: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte continues on Friday, October 9, 2026, at the Senate impeachment court. Here are the latest news and updates.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 37: What to expect

The Defense will continue its cross-examination of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) witness on Friday, who is testifying on Article 2 of the impeachment case accusing Vice President Sara Duterte of amassing unexplained wealth.
BIR Office of the Commissioner chief of staff Atty. Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez is set to return to the witness stand once the trial resumes at 10 a.m.
Once cross-examination ends, the prosecution and the defense will each have an opportunity for redirect and recross-examination of the witness.
Senator-judges will thereafter be given two minutes each for their interjections.
